conservative_backtest_availability_rule: Use official FILED AS OF DATE / master-index filing date as a date-level anchor only; permit strategy use from the first full XNYS session strictly after that date. Do not use report date or acceptance timestamp as first-public time.
rule_interpretation: 17 CFR 232.13 uses the time direct transmission commences, not ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME. The 14 after-cutoff acceptance/date-shift rows are consistent with next-business-day filing, but do not prove when transmission commenced. The one same-filed-date acceptance after 17:30 remains unresolved and is not treated as a rule violation.
sec_business_calendar: Monday-Friday excluding observed US federal holidays, per SEC EDGAR status guidance
